test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**From among the words given in bold, select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

Kathmandu is vivid, **mercenery**, religious with small **shrines **to flower-adomed **deities **along the **narrowest **and busiest streets.
solution:
The correct answer is: **mercenery**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**mercenery**' is the incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence.
 
• The correc t spelling is "**M****ercenary**.' 
 
• **Mercenary **means interested only in the amount of money you can get from a situation. (किराये का)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shrines **means a holy place for worship because of a connection with a holy person or object. (पूजा के लिए एक स्थान जो किसी पवित्र व्यक्ति या वस्तु के संबंध के कारण पवित्र हो)
 
• **Deities **mean a god or goddess. (देवता या देवी)
 
• **Narrowest **means of little breadth or width; not broad or wide. (थोड़ी चौड़ाई या चौड़ा नहीं)

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**, which is incorrectly spelt.

**Corrected sentence:** *Kathmandu is vivid, mercenary, religious with small shrines to flower-adomed deities along the narrowest and busiest streets.*
